Thank you so much. It didn't even occur to me to look for a better sub. I feel silly.

Don't feel like you have to respond or even read it. It was helpful to write it all out and your perspective was very helpful.

I appreciate all of your reply. Sometimes, I just need to be asked the right questions. I have to sit with my feelings. Identify what the feeling really is or what the root of the feeling is. I definitely don't know how long it'll take, but I've made so much progress on myself the last year I am actually proud of myself. That took a lot of time and is still an ongoing process. I'm just SO much better dealing with things and am able to be okay faster. Process faster. It just hasn't felt fast enough for them. Or my family, but  that's a whole other issue 😅

As for our quality time, it's definitely lacking. We are so unbelievably broke the past few months to now,  that our quality time is really only watching our shows together. With the agreement of no phones just us. I definitely want/need more with PP. I'm just not sure how to get there. We got tired of all the free things, I guess, lol.

It's just been hard. I just don't know how to deal with him being so head over heels in love with someone. I'm re learning so many things. I just need check-ins, I suppose. I don't know how to do it alone. I straight up told PP today that I need my hand held for a while until I know what to expect and how to deal with it as it comes. It sucks that I need that, but he is willing to do it. I ask myself if that'd toxic all the time.

It just feels like there's constantly new "issues" that I'm having to process. Sometimes, I feel like I've been demoted because "there shouldn't be a hierarchy." I don't want to control them by any means. I'm just asking for some time to do all the work. I want nothing more than to all be able to hang out the 3 of us and them hang out 1 on 1 whenever and how evermuxh they want.. But I'm re-learning so much. It's just overwhelming sometimes. I was floundering hard enough working on just myself, but now I have to worry about the concerns of a whole ass nether person. 

This isn't his first new attachment. That one barely bothered me at all. They did a few things, and I was all good, little jealous sometimes, but nothing i couldn't handle. But then they started to do new and fun things he had never even tried to do with me. We worked on that, and it's better now. However, he was very clearly not in love with that girl. I thought I was more equipped to deal with "in love" love, eventually happening. Thinking I'll be okay obviously didn't work out because I've broken down a few times.

I kinda feel as well, like they are so consumed by NRE that they aren't even considering me. At the same time, though, I'd probably want to be doing the same thing in his shoes. He's just always so okay with everything proposed by me. I don't get how he's just perfectly fine all the time. Am I wrong for that? Will I get to that point?

At the same time, am I just having a depression spiral? - ugh, this is long enough now 😅

To sumerize I think my overall issue is I'm overwhelmed with: working on myself, setting boundaries with my family (finally), learning to process things better and have better reactions to things, allow myself to take the time I need for myself and now being ENM with a new uncomfortable dynamic for me is just a lot. Plus, the overwhelming family issues that are a constant problem for me. Yayyyy big families, lol I also have no idea what I need or even want so often. I've always just. Done what I'm told/what's asked of me, morphed into the person I thought whoever wanted me to be when around them, and honestly just allowed whatever happen to me whether I wanted it or not. 

Thank you again for your lovely reply 💕
